key_highlights: Severe market correction wipes $169 billion from ASX valuation in broad risk-off sell-off.
Cumulative RBA rate hikes severely curtail borrowing capacity, accelerating Sydney and national housing downturns.
Retail distress deepens as David Jones slashes 1,700 roles, presenting market share upside for Myer (MYR.AX).
Gold exploration and critical minerals recovery breakthroughs offer selective junior resource resilience.

sectors.trend: Gold exploration assets and rare earth recovery breakthroughs attract speculative capital despite broader market weakness.
sectors.implications: Favour low-cost gold producers and critical minerals explorers; maintain cautious outlook on bulk commodity majors facing soft external demand.

sectors.trend: Major banks face headwinds from steep home value declines, crimped mortgage borrowing power, and corporate governance scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Elevated risks of slowing loan growth, mortgage margin compression, and potential bad debt provision increases across the Big Four.

sectors.trend: Department store restructuring accelerates with David Jones redundancies, while supermarkets face ACCC expansion hurdles and GLP-1 dietary shifts.
sectors.implications: Myer positioned to capture displaced market share; supermarkets face regulatory caps on organic growth and shifting consumer basket composition.

sectors.trend: AI-driven corporate restructurings, hiring freezes, and capital raisings accelerate, while private AI valuations surge.
sectors.implications: ASX tech valuations remain pressured by higher bond yields, though enterprise AI adoption remains an active capital raising theme.

sectors.trend: Deadlocked COP31 negotiations highlight fossil fuel transitions, amid rising Middle East transit tensions and domestic transition project scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Near-term support for traditional energy equities on supply route disruption risk, countered by policy uncertainty.

key_themes: Macroeconomic tightening reaching inflection point with severe mortgage and housing market stress
Broad ASX equity capitulation with $169B weekly capitalization drawdown
Department store consolidation and retail polarization
Safe-haven pivot toward gold and defensive positioning amid AUD softness

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight retail banks and residential REITs; increase cash and short-duration liquid assets.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Monetary Policy Over-Tightening & Labour Market Deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Prioritize quality non-cyclicals and defensive healthcare leaders with resilient pricing power.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Middle East Geopolitical Shock & Strait of Hormuz Disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain tactical allocation to unhedged energy producers and gold miners.
Screen for regulatory friction in M&A targets and ensure rigorous governance compliance in major holdings.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight ASX gold producers and near-term restart developers
opportunities.rationale: Strong commodity price backdrop, domestic currency tailwinds, and haven demand insulate earnings.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long positioning in Myer Holdings
opportunities.rationale: Direct beneficiary of David Jones workforce cuts, concession departures, and supplier migration.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to critical minerals with proven processing recovery breakthroughs
opportunities.rationale: High-recovery processing technology de-risks project economics in high-demand strategic minerals.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to major Australian retail banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Rapidly deteriorating housing market values and constrained borrowing capacity elevate credit risk and suppress volume growth.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Implement downside portfolio hedging on the ASX 200
defensive_moves.rationale: Broad market momentum broken following $169B weekly loss with key technical supports failing.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight discretionary retail and retail-heavy REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Department store contraction, consumer real income constraints, and hiring cuts threaten leasing spreads and discretionary spending.

market_outlook.short_term: Cautious and defensive across 1–3 months as the ASX 200 consolidates after substantial weekly losses amid acute housing and rate headwinds.
market_outlook.long_term: Cyclical recovery contingent on prospective RBA policy easing, stabilization in property valuations, and resource support from global infrastructure.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statement and forward guidance on terminal interest rates
Australian housing market clearance rates and monthly CoreLogic price index updates
Christmas retail trading updates and Black Friday sales data across major retailers
Geopolitical developments regarding energy shipping routes in the Middle East
Outcomes of COP31 climate negotiations affecting fossil fuel transition targets

CoreLogic Sydney and national dwelling value indices
Gold spot prices (USD and AUD terms) and iron ore 62% Fe CFR benchmarks
